글로벌 투자은행(IB) 골드만삭스가 총 117억달러(약 15조9000억원) 상당의 사모펀드 자금을 조성했다. 골드만삭스는 15일 대체투자 사업의 프라이빗에쿼티(PE) 부문 자사의 플래그십 바이아웃(경영권 인수) 펀드인

Global investment bank Goldman Sachs has raised a total of USD 11.7 billion (approximately KRW 15.9 trillion) in private equity funds.

On September 15, Goldman Sachs announced that it had completed the final closing for its flagship buyout fund in the alternative investment business, "West Street Capital Partners IX (WSCP IX)", along with related investment vehicles in its private equity division.

WSCP IX was established with USD 9.6 billion (approximately KRW 13.05 trillion). In addition, the Asia-Pacific-focused private equity fund "West Street Asia Equity Partners I (WSAEP I)" raised more than USD 1.6 billion (approximately KRW 2.175 trillion), and associated co-investment vehicles secured USD 500 million (KRW 679.7 billion).

The investment targets of WSCP IX are high-quality mid-sized companies that can be acquired through buyouts, with a focus on the United States and Europe. The fund has already invested in U.S. cybersecurity firm Shelman, sports management company Excel Sports, European medical device manufacturer Numantech, and project management firm Mace, among others.

Brad Gross, Global Co-Head of Private Equity within Goldman Sachs’ Alternative Investments division, stated, "We will leverage our global network and expertise to identify differentiated investment opportunities and accelerate value creation for our portfolio companies."

Goldman Sachs’ alternative investment arm manages over USD 706 billion (approximately KRW 960 trillion) in assets. It also operates a wide range of alternative investment strategies, including private equity, growth equity, venture capital (VC), private credit, real estate, and infrastructure.
